summary: Show the selected replication route's preferred/fallback state and preferred-route retry deadline in per-peer worker status.

replay.detail: Status is host-local and does not replay or rewrite claims.

schema.detail: No database, stored format, index or migration changes.

rules.detail: No claim vocabulary, admission, checkpoint or retention changes.

compatibility.detail: Worker status adds optional route_is_preferred and preferred_retry_at_unix_ms fields. Missing fields from older workers remain readable. Phase-only updates retain the latest route selection; a new preferred-route selection clears the pending preferred retry. The text replication status prints the same information.

manual.detail: Normal binary upgrade; no configuration or operator state conversion.

recovery.detail: Reporting only; route selection, cooldowns and failover behavior are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Ordinary binary restart; no measured downtime or incident-cure claim.
